Simple rules for shade areas in detail
This section sets out why careful work counts

Companion Animal Travel Desk shade-area handling

We keep pet movement calm, clean, and easy to track. The desk team checks every booking against crate fit, health papers, and the cabin team notes before any animal moves on. If anything looks off, stop the handoff and sort it out right away. Keep owners informed in plain language and stay steady with them, because clear talk prevents rushed mistakes.

For reptile cases, follow the file closely and do not improvise. <<FACT F078>>. The health certificate must be checked as part of the same review and filed before release. <<FACT F084>>. Use the cabin team alert only after the desk record is complete and the animal is cleared for travel.

Rabbit bookings need the same careful eye on container size and handling marks. <<FACT F070>>. If the crate looks worn, if the latch is loose, or if the label is unclear, hold the booking and get a fresh check. Use clean gloves, keep noise low, and move the animal without sudden shifts.

We aim for dependable companion travel at Aurelia Skyways, so the desk never skips a step for speed. The senior coordinator should be told about repeat issues, and any welfare concern goes straight up the chain. Keep the log tidy, keep the tone calm, and keep the handoff smooth. Contact the shift lead or the senior coordinator if anything is unclear.
